files.ops/logger-notes.md:
# Logger notes

The Doset-4 dosing log reaches logs/ through the pump house logger. During sd card swaps and maintenance the logger pauses, and the entries in between are not backfilled; the card itself keeps the raw entries for 30 days and can be read out at the pump house.
